content:
Factor pairs of \(56\) have sums \(57,30,18,15\).  
Factor pairs of \(50\) have sums \(51,27,15\).

The total number of blue points must be the same for both red points, so the only possible common sum is
\[
n=15.
\]
This is consistent, e.g. with 7 blue points left of the first red point, 3 between the red points, and 5 right of the second red point.

\[
\boxed{15}
\]
